name: Condiment inventory
pitch: Build a list of current condiments and suggest homemade recipes to replace them.
instructions: Start by listing any existing inventory file in the workspace. If no file exists, create a new table with columns: name, type, last used, replacement recipe. Read each line from any existing file and add it to the table. When a line has no recipe, use web_search to find a homemade replacement for that condiment. Record the recipe found in the table. After all items are processed, show the completed table to the person. If web_search finds no recipe, note that in the table and move on to the next item. End by asking the person if they want to keep, edit, or delete any entry.
readme:
# Condiment inventory

Build a list of current condiments and suggest homemade recipes to replace them.

**What it needs:**
- Reads and writes files in the workspace
- Shows a table of items and recipes
- Searches the web for replacement recipes

**What it will not do:**
- It cannot check your pantry or fridge physically
- It cannot buy ingredients or cook for you
- It cannot decide which recipes you prefer
